objective_interpretation: The review treats the donation page as a trust and framing decision for a first-time or converting donor, not as a general brand review.

activated_modules.reason: How the charity frames its cause against comparable charities is a positioning choice.
A first-time donor and a converting one-time donor weigh the same page differently.
The ask itself has to justify recurring giving, not just request it.
A donor choosing where to give compares this cause against others they could support.
The donation itself, what it funds and how it is framed, is the subject of the decision.
Impact proof is what turns an ask into a trusted request rather than a plea.
The donation page is what visitors arrive at before ever giving.
Converting a one-time donor to recurring is the second half of the stated decision.
The donation ask lives on a website page.
A recurring financial commitment to a cause rests on donor trust in how funds are used.

Broader charitable-giving trends are not what this quarter's decision turns on.
A donation is not a priced product; the ask is a suggested amount, not a fee structure.
No compliance driver was raised for this specific page.
The decision concerns visitors who already arrived, not being found.
No press or third-party sentiment signal was anticipated going in.
Programme delivery operations are out of scope for a donation-page decision.
